text: Loop-closure consistency: A → B → A must look the same
description: Unsupervised spatial consistency (object permanence) along random camera loops, including translation loops.

status.comment: Implemented: train.margin (36dddc2) and train.loop (78757e3; the last prediction warped back to step 1's camera by the composed inverse, dt 0, L1 vs the step-1 prediction where both covered; synthetic transform check 0.047 vs 0.254 wrong). A/B 2026-11-24, 500 its from nice-net, both gate 1 + margin 8 (runs/gatemargin vs runs/gateloop, loop 1.0), evaluate.py 64 x 96 mean L1: all 0.0734 vs 0.0732, holes 0.0611 vs 0.0611: no effect. Likely because the 8-step training rollouts are mostly forward motion with observe blends toward the real frames, so loops rarely leave anything to remember. The margin itself is the useful part (border holes mostly vanish).
